lesson.name: Learn the King's Indian Defense
lesson.description: Learn the essentials of the King's Indian Defense with an educational video on move order, pawn structures, and key themes to know.

{How should Black meet White's premature e5 advance?} 5... dxe5 {[%wrong White
is doing well. Try to find a stronger move.] [%hint Open the d-file.]} (5...
Nfd7 $2 6. exd6 {White is doing well. Try to find a stronger move.}) (5... Ng8
$2 6. exd6 {White is doing well. Try to find a stronger move.}) 6. dxe5 {
Good move! How should you take advantage of the open d-file?} Qxd1+ {[%wrong
White has a good position. Try to find a stronger move.] [%hint Trade queens
to prevent White from castling or to make White retreat a knight.] Well
played! Either way that White can recapture on d1 puts a piece on a bad square.
Black is slightly better.} (6... Ng4 $2 7. Qxd8+ {White is doing well. Try to
find a better move.}) (6... Nfd7 $2 7. f4 {White is OK. Try to find a better
move.}) *

{White has built a big pawn center, but Black can break it down with an OK
position. How should you attack a white center pawn?} 6... c5 {[%wrong There's
a better move. Try to find it.] [%hint Target the d4 pawn and attempt to open
the long diagonal for your g7 bishop.]} (6... Na6 $5 {This delays a central
confrontation, but supports c5 on the next move. Try to find an immediate way
to attack the white center.}) (6... e5 $2 7. fxe5 {White is slightly better.
Try to find a stronger move.}) 7. d5 {Good move! How should you attack the
White d-pawn again?} e6 {[%wrong There's a better move. Try to find it.] 
[%hint Trade off the d5 pawn.] Well played! White's center is under pressure
and Black's lead in development compensates for White's space advantage.} (7...
b5 $5 8. cxb5 {This is a risky, but playable gambit. However, most players
prefer to attack d5 right away. How?}) *

{Black has attacked White's b-pawn. How should White respond?} 10. bxa5 {
[%wrong There's a stronger option. Try to find it.] [%hint Capture a pawn.]
Well played! White has more space on the queenside and opening lines should
hasten the attack.} (10. b5 $2 b6 {The blocked queenside makes it difficult
for White to make progress. Try to find a stronger move.}) (10. Ba3 $5 {
This is an OK way to keep the queenside open and defend b4, but there's an
even better move. Try to find it.}) (10. a3 $2 axb4 {The pin on a3 prevents
White from recapturing. Try again.}) (10. Rb1 $2 axb4 {Black has a comfortable
position. Try to find a better move.}) *

{White has played the poor move, b4-b5. How should Black prevent White from
making further progress on the queenside?} 10... b6 {[%wrong There's a
stronger move. Try to find it.] [%hint Block the white b-pawn so that the
queenside will be completely locked.] Great move! White has no way to make
progress on the queenside, so Black has a free hand to attack on the kingside.}
(10... Nd7 $5 {This is a reasonable move, but we're looking to block the
queenside right away. How should you do it?}) (10... h6 $5 {This is a
reasonable move, but we're looking to block the queenside right away. How
should you do it?}) (10... Nh5 $5 {This is a reasonable move, but we're
looking to block the queenside right away. How should you do it?}) *

{Once the center is closed, Black's best plan is to advance the f-pawn to gain
space on the kingside and attack. How should you prepare this advance?} 9...
Nd7 {[%wrong There's a better move. Try to find it.] [%hint Retreat your
knight to prepare f7-f5.]} (9... Ne8 $5 {This is a good move, but it's a
little more popular to move the knight to another square. Try to find it.}) (
9... Nh5 $2 10. Bxh5 {White wins a pawn. Try to find a stronger move.}) 10. Nd3
{Good choice! How should Black start to expand on the kingside?} f5 {[%wrong
There's a stronger move. Try to find it.] [%hint Advance your f-pawn to attack
the center.] Well played! Black gains space on the kingside with a dangerous
attack.} *

{How should White defend the center after Black's f5 advance?} 11. f3 {[%wrong
There's a stronger move. Try to find it and check the hint if you're stuck.] 
[%hint Defend e4 with a pawn.] Good choice! White can follow up with Be3 or
Bd2 to complete development and defend the dark squares, while the pawns
defend the light squares.} (11. Kh1 $5 {This is playable, but there's a more
popular move which defends the center. Try to find it.}) (11. Bg5 $5 {This is
playable, but there's a more popular move which defends the center. Try to
find it.}) (11. Bf3 $2 Nf6 {The bishop will soon be vulnerable on f3. Try to
find a safer move involving that square.}) *

{The c5 knight is well placed. How should Black prevent White from attacking

[%hint Defend b4 with a pawn.] Good move! This is a common idea to secure a
piece on c5 in the King's Indian.} (9... Nh5 $5 {This is a reasonable move,
but we're looking to prevent White from playing b4. How should you do it?}) (
9... Na6 $2 10. a3 {White can play b4 soon with a big space advantage. Try to
find a stronger option.}) *

{White has captured a pawn, but Black can win it back with a good position.
What should you play?} 9... Nxe4 {[%wrong There's a better move. Try to find
it.] [%hint Capture a pawn with a discovered attack on the e5 knight.]} (9...
Re8 $5 {This is reasonable, but there's an even better move. Try to find it.})
10. Nxe4 {Good move! What's next?} Bxe5 {[%wrong There's a stronger option.
Try to find it.] [%hint What should you capture?] Well played! Black has equal
material and a good position.} (10... Re8 $5 {This is a good move, but why not
make a capture right away?}) *

{How should Black give up the center in exchange for counterplay against the
White e-pawn?} 8... exd4 {[%wrong There's a better move. Try to find it and
check the hint if you're stuck.] [%hint Trade pawns to create a half-open
e-file.]} (8... c6 $5 {This is a reasonable move, but it's better to make a
useful trade. How should you do that?}) (8... a5 $5 {This is a reasonable move,
but it's better to make a useful trade. How should you do that?}) 9. Nxd4 {
Good start! How should you develop and attack the e4 pawn?} Re8 {[%wrong
There's a better move. Try to find it.] [%hint Control the e-file and target
e4.] Good work! Black's threats to the white center compensate for White's
space advantage.} (9... a5 $5 {This is a strong move, but there's a better
option. Try to find it.}) (9... Nc5 $5 {This is an OK move, but we're looking
for another piece that can develop to attack e4. Try to find it.}) (9... Qe7 $2
10. Re1 {The queen will be vulnerable on the e-file. Try to find a better
move.}) *
